method: Actual hashed candidate PBF decoding at zooms 0–6. Separate CHN/KOR/PRK scanline fill coverage against the immutable predecessor union, 8-unit row sampling and unchanged 1.5-unit quantization coast bound. Edge vertices and segment midpoints checked against both incident decoded fill boundaries; per-coordinate subpixel exceptions recorded. Exact detail mesh segments, symmetric adjacency, ID-mapped non-target geometry and administrative/seed parent semantics independently checked.

unionReports.areaPolicy: Area summations are diagnostic. Complete original ring, hole and finite-segment coverage is certified per coordinate at the unchanged repository representation policy; no aggregate area tolerance is widened.
